notes.title: Developer Log | September 2024
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox Members![/b][/h3]

Welcome to our latest Developer Log! As we dive into the spooky season, it’s only fitting that we’re bringing you some exciting updates on this ominous [b]Friday the 13th[/b]! We’ve been hard at work improving the game, ironing out bugs, and prepping for what's ahead. So, buckle up for the latest news about [b]SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]New Update - Version 0.2.11: Bug Fixes and Stability[/b][/h2]
In this update, we've focused on addressing [b]key issues[/b] reported by the community and improving the overall [b]stability[/b] of the game. From resolving [b]crashes and freezes[/b] to improving [b]networking and gameplay mechanics[/b], this update aims to create a [b]smoother[/b] and more enjoyable experience for all players. Below, you'll find a detailed breakdown of the most notable changes.

[h3][b]Updated Netcode[/b][/h3]
To enhance [b]multiplayer performance[/b], we’ve made several important updates to the game’s [b]networking[/b]. We’ve integrated [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/multiplayer/steamdatagramrelay]Steam Datagram Relay[/url], which improves connection stability, especially for players in [b]high-latency situations[/b]. Additionally, we’ve introduced a [b]latency display[/b] next to the FPS counter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/02c83ce68fe9bd92897d1b5916510d40ec8f2ed2.png[/img]

This indicator changes color based on the current latency value, providing players with better real-time insight into their [b]network connection[/b].

[h3][b]Improvements for Night Vision Goggles[/b][/h3]
We've implemented several improvements to the [b]Night Vision Goggles[/b], focusing on both [b]functionality[/b] and [b]user experience[/b]. The visibility of [b]text[/b] and [b]battery charge indicators[/b] has been enhanced when using the blue version of the goggles, ensuring that [b]vital information[/b] is more clearly displayed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/9898c73451155c3a6e9c48aede4fcc1f2c9937ad.png[/img]
The [b]font size[/b] has also been scaled down for both the blue and green goggles to ensure better [b]readability[/b] during gameplay. Finally, a bug that caused the Night Vision Goggles to update their stats, like battery charge, even when the game was paused has been [b]fixed[/b].

[h3][b]Critical Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
In this update, we've addressed a number of important issues to enhance overall gameplay. Several [b]critical bugs[/b] were addressed, including a freeze that occurred when NTF teammates entered search mode in areas like [b]SCP-049's chamber[/b], as well as a crash related to saving in [b]SCP-205's containment area[/b]. These fixes should greatly improve [b]stability[/b] during critical moments. Additionally, we've made various other improvements and [b]optimizations[/b] to further smooth out gameplay and fix minor issues that have been reported.

The update is [b]NOW available[/b] for download and the full changelog can be found here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1304510/view/4598826212612661235]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1304510/view/4598826212612661235[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Sneak Peek Into v0.3.0[/b][/h2]
As we continue working on [b]version 0.3.0[/b], we’re excited to share a couple of new features that will enhance your [b]gameplay experience[/b]. These updates bring fresh elements to the game, giving you even more [b]control and immersion[/b] during your missions. Here's a glimpse of what’s coming!

[h3][b]Classic Mode: Containment Status Bar[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/9579788da50e4ebc8d85e54e74939fa3dcad3f83.png[/img]
We've added a [b]status bar[/b] in Classic mode that appears when containing SCPs. This handy feature allows players to monitor the [b]progress[/b] of the current containment effort. If the player goes too far away, the containment would stop.

[h3][b]Nine-Tailed Fox Speed Boost[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/23f98094cfe6addee3b575e76ec4232f276e9a6b.png[/img]
Our teammates have hit the gym and are now in top shape! They've gained the ability to [b]run alongside[/b] the player, matching your [b]speed[/b]. This improvement means your backup is never too far behind, ready to assist whenever needed.

[h3][b]Localization Transition: Moving from Crowdin to Weblate[/b][/h3]
In an effort to improve our [b]localization process[/b] and work more closely with our [b]community[/b], we’ve transitioned from Crowdin to [b]ZiYue Weblate[/b], a platform now hosted by our dedicated community members. This move not only allows for more efficient [b]translation management[/b] but also gives our passionate players an easier way to contribute to localizing [b]SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/2440d2f34b5a5b47983ae021163559e20dd8d862.png[/img]

We believe this shift will result in more [b]accurate[/b] and timely updates for all language versions of the game, and we’re excited to see how this [b]collaboration[/b] improves the [b]global experience[/b]!

The Weblate project for SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox can be found here: [url=https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/engage/scpntf/]https://weblate.ziyuesinicization.site/engage/scpntf/[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Community Artwork[/b][/h2]
As a tradition for the Developer Logs, we want to share some artwork that was made for the game!

by [b][i]cool.so.sandwich[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/3535654958429971c7adab43db504ca78097c40f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Want to submit your artwork?[/b][/h3]
You can submit your SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox community artwork on our [url=https://discord.gg/invite/third-subdivision-studios-303301693158981634][u]Discord server[/u][/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/scpntf/][u]Subreddit[/u][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TSS_Games][u]Twitter / X[/u][/url], or send it via E-Mail at [u]contact@thirdsubdivision.com[/u]!

[h3][b]Want to report bugs?[/b][/h3]
To report a bug, simply use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304510/discussions/][u]Steam’s Discussion forum[/u][/url] to do so. Also, you can [url=https://discord.gg/invite/third-subdivision-studios-303301693158981634][u]join our Discord server[/u][/url] too!

[hr][/hr] 
We want to say [u][b]THANK YOU[/b][/u] for still being with us and supporting us!

[h3]And don’t forget – Wednesday is pizza day![/h3]

[i]-Vane Brain, from Third Subdivision Studios[/i]

notes.title: v0.2.11 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We appreciate the community's patience and invaluable feedback. Thank you for helping us make SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox the best it can be!

Save files from version 0.2.10 are [b]compatible[/b] with this version.

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgraded the game engine to the latest version, providing improved error reporting, along with various optimizations and bug fixes.
[*] Improved the loading speed of localization strings (by ZiYueCommentary).
[*] Reduced the camera shake amount from the knockback for all weapons.
[*] Fixed weapons with low knockback (such as Beretta M9) not playing its shooting sound when firing the last bullet.
[*] Fixed SPAS-12 aiming position to be more screen centered (by scp-963-2).
[*] Few miscellaneous SFX fixes, like adding missing crowbar holster sound (by SlendyOfDaMawn).
[*] An attempt to optimize the rendering of props by adding culling distance.
[*] The option to change the brightness of the game has been temporarily removed until brightness functionality is fixed.
[/list]
[h2]SINGLEPLAYER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements for Night Vision Goggles:
    [list]
    [*] Improved visibility of text and battery charge indicator while using blue Night Vision Goggles;
    [*] Improved the calculation of NPC position while using blue Night Vision Goggles;
    [*] Scaled down the font size when using blue and green versions of Night Vision Goggles;
    [*] Fixed a bug where Night Vision Goggles were updating their stats (like battery charge) even when the game was paused;
    [*] SCP-1048-A should no longer appear in blue Night Vision Goggles after the explosion;
    [*] Removed the built-in Night Vision Goggles, which was possible to activate by pressing the F key.
    [/list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when an NTF teammate goes into search mode in some areas (such as SCP-049's containment chamber or SCP-939 storage area).
[*] Fixed occasional crash in Singleplayer caused by the game not properly resetting after leaving Multiplayer.
[*] Fixed SCP-939's death animations not playing correctly.
[*] Fixed SCP-939's death animations not being set after loading a save file.
[*] Fixed a game crash when saving inside SCP-205 containment chamber and then attempting to load the save.
[*] The checkpoint elevators now reset their position if the player used the elevator but was captured by SCP-106.
[*] SCP-106's timer and state now reset if the player moves to another zone via checkpoint elevator. This way players won't face the Old Man within seconds after getting back to the zone.
[*] Fixed the world model of "Note from Daniel" using the paper version instead of the sticky note.
[*] Fixed render clipping on the security camera feed that was visible in some cases.
[*] Removed Surveillance Room event (surveil_room) until a better alternative is created.
[/list]
[h2]MULTIPLAYER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated netcode:
    [list]
    [*] Enhanced networking by integrating Steam Datagram Relay, improving connection stability and performance, especially in high-latency scenarios;
    [*] Few small optimizations in sending and receiving item packets.
    [/list]
[*] Added latency display next to the FPS counter. The latency indicator changes color based on the latency value for better visibility.
[*] Added additional buttons in the Host Server menu tab to hint at the possibility of selecting Multiplayer maps and gamemodes.
[*] Added a delay before spectators can switch to other players after dying.
[*] Players now emit pain sounds when getting shot by an enemy.
[*] Fixed text filtering not working correctly in the server list.
[*] Fixed the GUI frame of the lobby chat incorrectly rendering on resolutions higher than 1080p.
[*] In Waves, fixed the shriek sound of SCP-1048-A looping during the freeze state.
[*] In Waves, fixed SCP-035's tentacles (the ones on the spine) attacking players even after everyone was killed.
[*] An attempt to fix the duplicate item-picking sound for clients.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Log | April 2024
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox Members![/b][/h3]

Welcome to our latest Developer Log! This one special, as we celebrate SCP - Containment Breach's 12th Birthday, announce our participation in FPS Fest and.. a new update? Let's dive in!

[hr][/hr] 
[h2][b]Happy Birthday, SCP - Containment Breach![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/08d7ef6c1fd91bfbb8ceab02c88357335f78154f.png[/img]
[b]April 15th[/b] marks the [b]12th birthday of SCP - Containment Breach[/b], a game that has thrilled and chilled a legion of fans with its unforgettable, eerie atmosphere. First and foremost, SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox is a [b]survival horror game[/b] that carries forward this legacy, built [b]originally[/b] as a [b]modification[/b] for SCP - Containment Breach. Thanks to the groundbreaking path laid by the original game, SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox continues to immerse players in a world of suspense and supernatural terrors, proving that the spirit of the original game is alive and more haunting than ever. 

As we [b]celebrate[/b] this milestone, we salute the [b]original creators[/b] and the vibrant [b]community of fans[/b] and [b]modders[/b] who keep the corridors of SCP eternally spine-chilling. Their passion and creativity fuel the evolution and expansion of this dark universe. Here's to many more years of survival horror excellence and innovative community-driven storytelling!

[h2][b]Participation in Steam’s FPS Fest[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/26d2570d3a8f792215b91ec506e4ce505d8181cc.png[/img]
Second - SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox is a [b]First Person Shooter[/b] that stands out for its immersive gameplay and heart-pounding horror elements. We are excited to announce that our game is [b]participating[/b] in Steam's [b]FPS Fest[/b], showcasing the intense and unique experiences that our title offers within the shooter genre.

This festival is a fantastic opportunity for both new and veteran players to dive into the chilling world of SCP, bringing together fans from across the globe. As you navigate [b]the treacherous environments[/b] and [b]confront the unknown[/b], remember that each moment in SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox is a test of both your survival skills and your nerves.

[h2][b]Update v0.2.10: Stability, Performance Improvements and More![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/bad13966b4f796dc6beff9135bc9e66a12b1aaad.png[/img]
Because of the reasons above, we decided that this is a great time to release [b]an update[/b] for SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox. Originally, most of the bug fixes were intended for release in [b]version 0.3.0[/b]. However, as development extended beyond our initial timeline, we received [b]numerous bug reports[/b] from our [b]dedicated community[/b]. These issues ranged from minor glitches to [b]critical, game-breaking problems[/b]. Given the impact on gameplay and in our commitment to delivering the best experience possible, we decided it was crucial to address these issues.

As a result, we've decided to [b]backport fixes from version 0.3.0[/b] into [b]this update[/b], aiming to enhance stability, improve performance, and ensure that all players have a smoother and more enjoyable experience as they navigate the eerie and unpredictable halls of SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox. We appreciate the community's patience and invaluable feedback. Thank you for helping us make SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox the best it can be!

The update is [b]available NOW[/b] for download and the changelog can be found here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1304510/view/7816635004477772157]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1304510/view/7816635004477772157[/url]

Apart from regular bug fixes, this upcoming update brings a variety of notable changes. Here’s what to expect in version 0.2.10:

[h3][b]Integration of dgVoodoo[/b][/h3]
For the past four months we’ve been testing out the addition of [b]dgVoodoo[/b] into the game on a separate Steam branch, aiming on [b]fixing the game’s poor performance[/b] on newer GPUs. The tests turned out to be [b]really successful[/b] and thus we’ve decided to officially add this library into the game.

[h3][b]Map Size Reduction[/b][/h3]
We've heard your feedback loud and clear! Many of you mentioned that, while the facility's [b]vast size[/b] was impressive, it sometimes [b]felt too cumbersome[/b]. In response, we've [b]scaled down[/b] the map sizes across all three zones:[list]
[*] The Entrance Zone now measures [b]9x9[/b] units, down from 12x12.
[*] Both the Light and Heavy Containment Zones are now [b]12x12[/b] units, reduced from 18x18.[/list]
We hope these changes will enhance your navigation and progression through the facility, making for a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/6dcef3802bef9c2283b6e5446ee27e8c25519d72.png[/img][i]An example of new map size in the Entrance Zone. Interesting how the map was generated in a shape of jack-o'-lantern![/i]

[h3][b]Soft Lock Fixes[/b][/h3]
Changes have been made to room layouts involving SCP-513 and SCP-966 containment chambers. Previously, these rooms were shaped in a 3-way configuration with [b]one way locked[/b] behind a keycard door, which could lead to a [b]soft lock situation[/b] if players lacked the necessary keycard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/4966f5e569e823fff27d836e4973b776dfbad765.png[/img][i]New locked entrance in SCP-513's containment chamber[/i]

The rooms have now been redesigned into a 2-way corner room to prevent such issues and facilitate smoother gameplay transitions.

[h3][b]Disclaimer Screens[/b][/h3]
To better inform our players and ensure safety, we've added a new [b]disclaimer[/b] about [b]potential seizure risks[/b] due to elements like flashing lights or muzzle flashes from weapons. This is particularly important as we welcome many new players to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/e7d36c90399e92ee06c703846c303721ac9cbdf1.png[/img][i]Disclaimer with the seizure warning[/i]

We've also included a reminder that SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox is [b]still[/b] in [b]Early Access[/b]. This serves to clarify that the game is not yet complete, and continuous updates and new content are still to come, countering any misconceptions about the game’s development status.

[h3][b]Critical Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
As a final significant update in this version, we have addressed several critical bugs that were impacting gameplay. Here are some of the key fixes included in update v0.2.10:[list]
[*] [b]For Singleplayer[/b], we’ve resolved an issue where starting a new game could freeze due to a map generation bug. This fix ensures a smoother start and consistent gameplay. Also, we’ve fixed performance issues with the [b]S-NAV Navigators[/b], enhancing their reliability and functionality during missions.
[*] [b]For Multiplayer[/b], we’ve addressed a persistent issue where, after extended play, clients would not be able to see items scattered around the map.[/list]
We are continuously working to identify and resolve issues reported by our community, and we appreciate your continued feedback and support.


"[i][b]But wait! Where is version 0.3.0?[/b][/i]" you might ask. The answer is that it's still in development. Good news is that soon we are going to show more details about it! Stay tuned for that!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Community Artwork[/b][/h2]
As a tradition for the Developer Logs, we want to share some artwork that was made for the game!

by [b][i]Walokin[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/6bba401ce45fe86296ca8fc78df2fb920ba05bae.png[/img]
[h3][b]Want to submit your artwork?[/b][/h3]
You can submit your SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox community artwork on our [url=https://discord.gg/invite/third-subdivision-studios-303301693158981634][u]Discord server[/u][/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/scpntf/][u]Subreddit[/u][/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TSS_Games][u]Twitter / X[/u][/url], or send it via E-Mail at [u]contact@thirdsubdivision.com[/u]!

[h3][b]Want to report bugs?[/b][/h3]
To report a bug, simply use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304510/discussions/][u]Steam’s Discussion forum[/u][/url] to do so. Also, you can [url=https://discord.gg/invite/third-subdivision-studios-303301693158981634][u]join our Discord server[/u][/url] too!

[hr][/hr] 
We want to say [u][b]THANK YOU[/b][/u] for still being with us and supporting us!

[h3]And don’t forget – Wednesday is pizza day![/h3]

[i]-Vane Brain, from Third Subdivision Studios[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/dfc404b2cb474a1becc9eba09905c109cf22a7e5.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.2.10 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've decided to backport fixes from version 0.3.0 into this one, aiming to enhance stability, improve performance, and ensure that all players have a smoother and more enjoyable experience as they navigate the eerie and unpredictable halls of SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox.

We appreciate the community's patience and invaluable feedback. Thank you for helping us make SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox the best it can be!

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added dgVoodoo library (by Dege) as an attempt to fix crashes and performance issues that many users with modern AMD and NVIDIA GPUs encountered.
[*] Added disclaimers at the beginning of the game, warning about the game being in early access and seizure warnings.
[*] Fixed poor performance with text, caused by the localization system.
[*] Fixed loading screens image size getting bigger with each loading screen appearance.
[*] Improved the performance of some GUI functions.
[*] An attempt to smooth out the mouse look.
[*] Some memory usage optimizations and fixed memory leaks (many of which are fixed by Jabka).
[*] Fixed an issue with USP where the model was incorrectly mirrored.
[*] Changes related to launcher:[list]
[*] Added the ability to select GPU, replaces the graphics mode dropdown menu;
[*] The fullscreen mode now applies only if game resolution matches monitor resolution.[/list]
[/list]
[h2]SINGLEPLAYER[/h2]
[list]
[*] General map generation improvements:[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze upon starting a new game, caused by the map generation failure.
    [*] Fixed softlocks in SCP-513, SCP-914 and SCP-966 containment chambers.
    [*] Decreased the map size for Entrance Zone from 12 to 9 units;
    [*] Decreased the map size for Light and Heavy Containment Zones from 18 to 12 units;
    [*] An attempt to fix the map layout of LCZ and HCZ being identical.[/list]
[*] Weapon related changes:[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug with shotgun where it could be turned into a rifle by spamming the reload button;
    [*] Fixed the guns shooting if player has an item equipped from the inventory;
    [*] Fixed Radio Transceiver channel switching not working because of weapon selection;
    [*] Player now holsters the weapon when using S-Nav or Radio items and brings the weapon back when the items are not in use;
    [*] Fixed the player using iron sight after discarding an item with the right mouse button.[/list]
[*] Many improvements for S-NAV Navigators:[list]
    [*] Generally optimized the code for S-NAV Navigators;
    [*] Fixed performance issues caused by S-Nav Navigators due to duplicate rendering logic;
    [*] Fixed S-Nav Navigator Ultimate crashing the game if SCP-173 or SCP-106 where contained or do not exist;
    [*] Moved the SCP circle detection right where the player's triangle position is located.[/list]
[*] Improvements in Pocket Dimension:[list]
    [*] Fixed trenches. They now work just like in original SCP - Containment Breach;
    [*] Fixed fog colors in some cases, as well as fog color change after loading a save file;
    [*] Fixed decals not appearing after leaving Pocket Dimension;
    [*] Fixed a game crash when leaving Pocket Dimension caused by failing to find a good room to teleport to.[/list]
[*] Many fixes for SCP-970 room:[list]
    [*] Fixed occasional game crash related to items in the inventory;
    [*] Fixed the updating code for doors when player is going through the doors inside the room;
    [*] Fixed camera hiccup when going through doors;
    [*] Other minor fixes.[/list]
[*] Fixed a game crash when player gets fully infected by SCP-008.
[*] Fixed the gamemode reset after loading a save file while having Classic Mode ticked/unticked in the New Game tab.
[*] Fixed a bug where SCP-427 was not applying any effects on the player (by HonestResolv3).
[*] Fixed player falling down through metal grates in the grated hallway room (room2_pipes_1) after loading a save file.
[*] Fixed SCP-1048-A reappearing in some conditions when the ear bear suppose to be hidden.
[*] Fixed SCP-096's idle ambient sound playing even if player teleports far away.
[*] Added a small delay for D-Class before they start shooting.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to load into a new zone if player dies or gets kidnapped by SCP-106 in the checkpoint room.
[*] Fixed a bug where the light sprites would be drawn in the room where player died if player respawns far away.
[*] Fixed a bug where the announcements would play even if player hasn't open the Gate A blast doors yet.
[*] Fixed blood decals from the Entrance Zone lockroom (lockroom_2) appearing in other 2C shaped rooms.
[*] Fixed MTF teammates sometimes getting stuck at the Entrance Zone checkpoint.
[*] Fixed SCP-049's catwalk event in the four-way room (room4_1).
[*] Fixed medibay (room2_medibay) props being untextured.
[*] Fixed SCP-012's paper glowing inside its chamber.
[*] Fixed the smoke appearing in wrong places in the tunnel room (room2_tunnel_2) depending on room's rotation.
[*] Optimized and improved the code for events in following rooms: SCP-173 containment chamber (cont_173), SCP-500 and SCP-1499 chamber (cont_500_1499), Toilets room (room2_toilets).
[*] Some code improvements related to doors and buttons.
[/list]
[h2]MULTIPLAYER[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added text filtering to the server list (this includes server name, gamemode name, and the map).
[*] In Waves, an attempt to fix items breaking and glitching during the Multiplayer playthrough.
[*] In Waves, moved the fuse sprite a bit higher to not obstruct the model on the floor.
[*] In Waves, fixed a bug where dying by a tentacle would not count up as an actual death.
[*] Fixed player tags not appearing for users with AMD GPUs.
[/list]
...and other small fixes and improvements overall.

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Brightness setting and blur effect currently aren’t working at all.
[*] On some computers, the blinking fade-in can be bugged and appear semi-transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Log | December 2023
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]

We are coming back once again with a holiday special Developer Log! With this post we will be looking back at 2023 on the progress made so far and talk about what’s left for [b]version 0.3.0[/b]. But first of all, we’ve prepared [b]something special[/b] for our new players that had troubles with the game…

[i][u][b]Keep in mind that everything within the post is subject to change![/b][/u][/i]

[hr][/hr] 
[h2][b]Experimental Steam Branch[/b][/h2]
We’ve noticed an increased amount of people reporting the game crashing, specifically on many computers with [b]AMD GPUs[/b], as well as some [b]high-end NVIDIA GPUs[/b]. As a possible way to fix it, we’ve decided to use the [b]dgVoodoo2[/b] wrapper, allowing the game to be run as if it’s a DirectX 11 application.

Steps to access this branch can be found here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3122326419]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3122326419[/url]

This version also [b]fixes lags[/b] that many of you encountered in the main menu or [b]game freezing[/b] when starting a new game. We [b]HIGHLY[/b] recommend players [b]who had issues[/b] running the game to [b]switch to this branch[/b]. Also feel free to report any other crashes that happen with this version, but specify that you used this branch.

There are currently few [b]known issues[/b] in this version:
[list]
[*] [b]Brightness[/b] setting currently isn’t working at all.
[*] [b]Blur effect[/b] is broken and just darkens the screen.
[*] On some computers, the [b]blinking[/b] fade-in can be bugged out and appear semi-transparent.[/list]
Once we collect all the [b]feedback[/b] and make sure that this fix is working for everyone, we will add the dgVoodoo2 wrapper into v0.3.0.

[h2][b]Multiplayer - SCP-682 progress[/b][/h2]
One of the more important things we’ve been working on is the [b]map layout[/b] for SCP-682. The map needs to be big enough to let 682 roam around, but it shouldn’t be too large as to break immersion. A good combination of both is what we are aiming to accomplish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/0ff6c2ad20e340ad93f1381643be0c34b6afa399.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/6a5029cf946701ca5fecd2e49681b24447ae828b.png[/img]

The screenshots above show an [b]area[/b] which has been [b]destroyed by SCP-682[/b]. Each piece was modeled completely intact onto the wall itself and then broken up and scattered on the floor, in order to make it as realistic as possible.

We’ve also been working on [b]new mechanics[/b] for the Waves gamemode, such as [b]operating the blast doors[/b] of SCP-682’s chamber. We’ve taken some time to make sure other mappers can make their map work with 682 by adding new entities (without hardcoding too many features).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/fcfd03324e2897b92f9d65ef268c59d3e799aa08.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/033925f79ae116e7ae4a8ec1df832f9e992f5507.png[/img]

And of course, plenty of work was put into SCP-682 as well! His AI is almost complete, but requires some animations to be created. In the images below you can see the [b]hitboxes[/b] that we put on 682. And yes, while you [b]CAN[/b] shoot him, it doesn’t mean you can easily kill him.

Short explanation: The green hitboxes are used for the lowest amount of damage dealt to an NPC, designed to be used for arms, legs or tails, like in 682’s case. Yellow hitboxes are used for the body in general, they deal medium damage to an NPC. The red ones are critical hitboxes, primarily used for headshots or anything else that would do a lot of damage on an NPC. For 682’s case it’s only the head and his large jaw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/11fec6f51f8aef8c3393c028d2e0841550103f5e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/5da593f47916930c20bdfd401d3f4d405fa49205.png[/img]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
Some of the bugs which have been reported a long time ago are now fixed, such as the inability to use the Radio Transceiver, poor performance when using the S-Nav Navigator, or accidentally shooting the gun when using a keycard.

[h2][b]Summary of 2023[/b][/h2]
Let’s summarize what we’ve made this year for v0.3.0:
[list]
[*] SCP-682 in Waves mode, as well as the new Multiplayer map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/f20c4afce6d3393f22af48abd063c5a22046de04.gif[/img]
[*] Subtitles and improvements in the localization system.
[*] Softlock fixes to prevent players from getting stuck in locked rooms, as well as softlocks caused by saving the game progress at the wrong time.
[*] Disclaimers to warn players about seizure hazards, as well as a note that the game is still work in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/9a07cf8a60aad358e17f04308060b2fe591af078.png[/img]

[*] AI Improvements for some NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/567ee50c5170451477c6aeb592b60214e76f306c.png[/img]

[*] Added some sounds to the NPCs in Waves mode.
[*] Optimization and fixes to the multiplayer.
[*] Many other improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes.
[/list]
[h2][b]What’s left for v0.3.0?[/b][/h2]
To answer this question, there aren’t that many things left before it’s completed. Our current list consists of:

[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]

[h2][b]New Multiplayer Map[/b][/h2]
For the past few months [b]we worked hard[/b] on version 0.3.0. A lot of work has been put into [b]fixing bugs[/b] and programming [b]new features[/b]. Recently, progress has been going very well and thus we want to show off [b]a new map[/b] for Multiplayer!

notes.title: Developer Log | June 2023
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]

First month of the summer is about to end, so it’s time for us to show what we’ve been working on this time!
We had to skip the May Developer Log due to many events in our lives. We thank you for understanding and supporting us throughout this time!

[i][u][b]Keep in mind that everything within the post is subject to change![/b][/u][/i]

[hr][/hr] 
[h2][b]SCP-173 Code Rewrite[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/fbfb56ca43826cf15cac644c1210434d314d0c02.png[/img]
[b]The main villain[/b] of both SCP – Containment Breach and SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox finally gets a bit of treatment! To put it simply: SCP-173’s code was really outdated and has barely been changed since the early days of SCP CB. It was a bit confusing, as a result working with this SCP was complicated. Until now! [b]The code was cleared up[/b] to be [b]more optimized[/b] and allow future modifications to be added easily.

[h2][b]Major Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/d1e7ef03d2dcdd88c3fde03f5187d68758ae099b.png[/img]
For the past month we’ve been [b]ironing out many bugs[/b] that have been reported by players. Recently we’ve found a solution for a bug that bothered many of you since the release of SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox – [b]the game freezing[/b] when starting a new game. This was caused by the map generation algorithm failing to place some rooms in the Entrance Zone (because the map size of the this zone is smaller than the others).

[h2][b]Previous Changes.. Now in Action![/b][/h2]
Since most of our work this month was about bug fixes, we’ve decided to show a few things that we’ve mentioned in the previous developer logs in motion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/d9589c17db9e1ba635024ca96b04c7669e619464.gif[/img]
[i]SCP-096 getting electrocuted by Tesla gate.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/8f68cdfea4830602563db6c8bb04baa1fe4ace95.gif[/img]
[i]D-Class backing off and running away when the player is too close.[/i]

[h2][b]Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)[/b][/h2]
Over the past few months we’ve received many (and we mean it! [b][u]MANY![/u][/b]) questions about v0.3.0. Here [b]we're going to answer[/b] some common questions.

[h3]Q: When is v0.3.0 going to come out?[/h3]
[b]A: [/b]In short, we still aim to release v0.3.0 this year.
The long answer is that SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox [b]is a hobby project[/b] of ours. We work on this game [b]in our free time[/b] because we like to do it! As fans of SCP CB, we like to work on something for other fans! Unfortunately, [b]many people treat us like a huge studio[/b] (some even compared us to EA or Ubisoft which is quite questionable but also overwhelming). [b][u]We aren’t a huge team[/u][/b], and we are not working on this project as a full-time job. We have [b]many events[/b] happening currently in our personal lives.

Because of this, [b]it’s hard to determine the release date[/b]. We can’t tell which features will take what amount of time. The following plan is this: We finish what we’ve already shown, [b]we make new rooms[/b] and [b]a multiplayer map[/b] as well as also adding a few [b]extra voice lines[/b]. This is definitely possible to do within this year ([i]or even within the next few months if things go well[/i]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/567ee50c5170451477c6aeb592b60214e76f306c.png[/img]
And speaking of… We are planning to make [b]more developer livestreams[/b] on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ThirdSubdivisionStudios][u]YouTube channel[/u][/url]! We will be showing our work progress, as well as answering your questions live. Stay tuned if you are interested!

[h3]Q: Will there be an intro/ending in v0.3.0?[/h3]
[b]A: [/b][b]There won’t be an intro or an ending [u]in v0.3.0[/u][/b]. This requires more time for us to work on. But what we have as an idea for the intro is to make it an in-game, non-playable cinematic.

[h3]Q: Will there be a cooperative mode in v0.3.0?[/h3]
A: As we mentioned in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1304510/announcements/detail/3694683561719428805][u]previous Developer Log[/u][/url], [b]cooperative mode was delayed [u]for a future version[/u][/b] due to some complexity in adding the multiplayer component for the classic or even campaign mode. This is due to the fact that the current multiplayer was specifically designed to work the way it is right now and not taking anything else into account as of now.

[h3]Q: Will the Chaos Insurgency be added into the game?[/h3]
[b]A: [/b]Yes, the Chaos Insurgency is planned to be in the game as a stronger enemy for classic and campaign mode. However, it won’t be in v0.3.0.

[h3]Q: Will there be SCP-XXX and SCP-YYYY?[/h3]
[b]A: [/b]The current plan for us is to [b]improve what is already in the game[/b]. There are many interesting SCPs in the game currently that are not shown well. Our plan is to fix that and make them shine more.

This decision however allows us to release v0.3.0 sooner.

[h2][b]New SCPs to contain[/b][/h2]
We don’t want to leave you all with a lack of content for v0.3.0, so there are also some good news! Just like everybody asked, we’ve been working on [b]adding more containment procedures[/b] for [u]Classic Mode[/u]. Specifically: SCP-096 and SCP-049. 

[h3][b]SCP-096 – The Shy Guy[/b][/h3]
In v0.3.0’s Classic Mode it will now be possible to [b]contain SCP-096[/b]! Don’t worry, you and your teammates are equipped with a pair of SCRAMBLE gears to get the procedure done easily and safely.

[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]

March is ending very soon, so it’s time to show what we’ve been working on. This month was a bit stressful due to coop development, as a result we had a little break because of it. Regardless we have been working on other interesting features. So, here's what we’ve done since the last Developer Log.

[i][u]Keep in mind that everything within the post is subject to change![/u][/i]

[h2][b]Disclaimer screens[/b][/h2]
Since many new players are getting introduced to SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox, we’ve added [b]safety disclaimers[/b], warning about seizure and epilepsy that can be triggered in some cases (like flashing lights or the weapon’s muzzle flash).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/aefd9ec3ddf5f73c0c206621022638683d0f7ab8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/e7d36c90399e92ee06c703846c303721ac9cbdf1.png[/img]

Now there's also a reminder that the game is in Early Access, as there have been some misunderstandings regarding it and thus some people thought that the game is completely finished and no new content will be added, which is false. We still have a lot of plans for the game!

[h2][b]More Tasks[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Developer Log | December 2022
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]
We are back once again with the new Developer Log! And this time it’s Christmas Edition! We want to wrap this year with some development progress, as well as some statistics and community artwork.

[h2][b]Rewriting In-Game Events[/b][/h2]
Most in-game events in SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox are exactly the same as in SCP: Containment Breach. So much that their code hasn’t changed for ages! And this leads to an issue where old events start to give issues, bugs and crashes. We’ve been working on [b]rewriting some of the events[/b] for SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox. You might’ve seen some examples of that already, like with Tesla gates or the event where SCP-173 appears in a tunnel room in Heavy Containment Zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/48f73f6a6c0e5c81a80f50620bc0b3769d412556.png[/img]

As the most recent example of a rewritten event – here is one of the appearances of SCP-049 in Light Containment Zone. It’s a small event, but this kind of event brings atmosphere to the game. Can you spot him on this screenshot?

[h2][b]Improving Difficulty System[/b][/h2]
In the original SCP: Containment Breach, Euclid difficulty relies on monitors that are statically positioned in some of the rooms. This however brings an issue where some parts of the generated map lack these monitors, and as a result – players can’t save. To fix this we [b]introduce Save Terminals™[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/a6e033a40be1a2e992e69a6bdc65b93745895719.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/7956a213d55db074c100e57653d6cd8d76d1b316.png[/img]
[i]The model is work in progress and will be improved later on.[/i]

With Save Terminals™ we have [b]more control over the saving[/b] on Euclid difficulty. The system we’ve made allows almost every room to have the terminal™. Of course, we’ve worked on balancing this as well. Save Terminals™ appear with a check for a specific distance between each other. However, this is ignored with some rooms where the Save Terminal™ should always appear. One example is the Checkpoint rooms for each zone.

[h2][b]Translating The Game[/b][/h2]
To let the game support multiple languages, we’ve been working on the game’s translation. However, we are not a huge team and can’t translate the game ourselves. For this reason, [b]we’ve created a page on Crowdin[/b], allowing all fans with the language knowledge to [b]help us translate the game[/b]!
The page is available here: [url=https://crowdin.com/project/scp-nine-tailed-fox][u]https://crowdin.com/project/scp-nine-tailed-fox[/u][/url]. Tell us what other languages we should add on the list!

[h2][b]Steam Stats[/b][/h2]
Another thing to mention is the statistics of the game’s activity on Steam. We have around [b][u]230 000[/u] total downloads[/b], as well as [b]more than [u]2100[/u] total reviews[/b]!
On top of that – we’re on the list of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/top_february_2022][u][b]Top Steam Releases of February 2022[/b][/u][/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/6d772a8d24cbfe8f770dad27293c3adf3de627cc.png[/img]

We are happy to know that our game was one of the successful games on February, on par with games like… “Orc Massage”? [i]Well then…[/i]

[h2][b]Community Artwork[/b][/h2]
As the last thing for this Developer Log, we want to share some artwork that was made for the game!

by [url=https://discord.gg/zGWZcZPYHs][b][u]Kolya7519[/u][/b][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/f7f3c707085eacd0b2cbb79184500c09d25f153e.png[/img]

[hr][/hr] 
[b]It’s been a great year![/b] We have many things cooking behind the scenes that might see the light of the day within the new year…

[h3]Merry Christmas, everyone! And Happy New Year![/h3]

[h3][b]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/b][/h3]
We are back to talk more about the development of v0.3.0, as well as share some little sneak peeks of new features and share some nice community artwork!

[h2][b]Co-op Mode Progress[/b][/h2]
The cooperative mode was something we’ve been working hard on. Yet [u][b]the task itself is really complicated[/b][/u] to do: The code itself is based on Singleplayer, which is based on SCP – Containment Breach: It was initially made to be Singleplayer only. Adding Multiplayer components into this is possible, but really complicated. Thus, we don’t have any estimated release date for v0.3.0. However, [u][b]we plan to post updates[/b][/u] on it whenever we have something major to show or talk about.

[h2][b]Melee Improvements[/b][/h2]
Melee weapons now [b][u]hit all enemies in front of the player[/u][/b] in close range, rather than hitting only one enemy at a time. As a result, escaping hordes of zombies with melee is now much easier (but we don't recommend to get close to zombies in the first place!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/75cb2ebc21d5df4f37f51ed70ee9273e2a765624.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Developer Tools[/b][/h2]
We’ve been working on [b][u]new developer tools for room making[/u][/b]. Since SCP – Containment Breach, we’ve been using a really old program called “3D World Studio”. The program is old and it doesn’t even work on Windows 10, only up to Windows 7, thus some of the developers have to stay on older operating systems. Not to mention all the bugs this editor has and how it runs poorly with larger maps (like Multiplayer maps).

For those reasons, we’ve been working on a better alternative, called [b][u]CBRE-EX[/u][/b] ([b]C[/b]ontainment [b]B[/b]reach [b]R[/b]oom [b]E[/b]ditor - [b]Ex[/b]tended). Originally this program was made for the new SCP – Containment Breach v1.4, but it's development was cancelled, yet the program was mostly done. So now we are improving the program even more, extending its functionality to work with SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/5e2ec057ef15ef4f1ee17b9a13a16879886b9b0e.png[/img]

You can find the program [url=https://github.com/AestheticalZ/cbre-ex/][u][b]here on GitHub[/b][/u].[/url] It's still in development, but basic rooms can be added into SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox already.

notes.title: Steam Release: 6 Months Later
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings to all Nine-Tailed Fox soldiers![/h2]
[b]It’s been 6 months[/b] since SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox released on Steam! While the launch was pretty rough at the beginning, it was really successful! And over those 6 months we’ve worked on bug fixes and improvements for the game, bringing 9 updates. However, there are still many things that we have to improve as some mechanics that came from SCP – Containment Breach aren’t compatible with the usage of weapons.

[b]We would like to share some plans for the future of the game.[/b] [u][b]Version 0.3.0[/b][/u] has entered it's full development stage and new features are going to be added and many bugs will be fixed. Here are some things we are working on:

[h2]Co-op Mode[/h2]
The co-op mode is something that we get asked about every day! When we worked on the Steam release, we had no plans for a Co-op mode due to the planned story mode. But after collecting feedback about it, we’ve decided to change our priorities. We’ve started by adding Classic mode into the game, without major story elements, just like how the original modification was (thus the word “classic”). After hearing positive feedback about this mode, we’ve decided to base the Co-op mode on Classic mode, where instead of the AI teammates there will be real players.

[h2]Expanding Singleplayer[/h2]
New tasks, new rooms and new events. We want to fill up all empty zones with more content. We're also planning on expanding the story.

[h2]Weapon Improvements[/h2]
We’ve been collecting some ideas in regards of weapon improvements, like improving gun models and animations, as well as adding a few more guns into the game. One main thing that many complained about is the poor melee implementation. We want to make melee weapons to be more powerful against enemies.

[h2]“Infinite” Waves[/h2]
This is a side mode for the Waves mode, where the wave amount is not set and instead it keeps on going up, while the horde of enemies increases. There is no end to this, even after defeating the boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/11004d71b80469fc818d09b208a050e13791e8ac.png[/img]

[h2]Zombie Aggressiveness[/h2]
As an addition to improving the Waves mode, we’ve decided to make zombies a bit more dangerous for players. There is now an “aggressive” state for the zombies, which triggers after a while depending on how long you are running around near the zombies. Once it reaches the limit, the zombie start running towards the player. Upon getting really close, they catch the player and start biting him, while the player can’t move away and is only able to shoot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/eee12b1698e767abf550a23ecda27a60108bc6f8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047451/3005d040255b470501c575dd589511d1cf0eba2d.gif[/img]

… and many more things that we would like keep as a secret for now!

[i]Please keep in mind that this is work in progress, and some of the features are the subject of change and also can be moved to future versions.[/i]


We would like to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who was supporting us and is still supporting and following the development of the game. 
[h3]And don’t forget – Wednesday is pizza day![/h3]

[i]-Third Subdivision Studios[/i]

notes.title: It's out!
notes.notes:
The time has come! SCP: Nine-Tailed Fox is finally available on Steam for free! It took us a bit longer that we thought, but that's something that is usual to huge game mods ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
The progress went really far compared to how the mod looked in 2015, as originally it was just a small gun addition to SCP - Containment Breach!

We want to thank everyone for support, ideas and testing of the game!



Meanwhile we also want to point out that this is not the final version of the game! There are some bugs still in the game that you might encounter.

[b]The game freezes at loading screen when I started a new game![/b]
This can happen due to some issues in the map generation, causing the game to get into infinite loop. The solution for this is to try another map seed, while reporting to us the bugged seed.

[b]I roamed the whole facility! Is there a way to finish the game?[/b]
Currently there are no endings in the game. However this is for sure planned for the future!

[b]Some players are invisible in the Multiplayer![/b]
This issue is currently investigated

[b]Some events in Singleplayer are broken![/b]
We are currently working on updates to fix this issues


In any case feel free to make a bug report and we will see what's going on!

Thank you, and enjoy the game!
